message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: Wu (被告人吴某) involved in concealment of assets from illegal public deposit case, laundering money. He concealed and transferred shares, falsified contracts, false dates, to hide assets. He knew proceeds are from illegal public deposit (非法吸收公众存款) crime. So he is liable for money laundering (洗钱罪). Also possibly for fraud? He falsified contracts to conceal assets, but that's not necessarily fraud for obtaining money; it's more like concealment of criminal proceeds, i.e., “帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、变卖犯罪所得及其收益” which is money laundering under Article 191 of Criminal Law. Also possibly “伪造公司印章、文书罪” but not described. The main is money laundering. Also maybe “非法吸收公众存款罪” is for the original perpetrators, not Wu. He is not the one who raised deposits. So only money laundering.

Thus single crime: 洗钱. According to correction rule: list only statutory offense name without “罪”. So just “洗钱”. Output format: [罪名]洗钱<eoa>.
